'''Policybazaar''' is an Indian [[insurance]] [[Data aggregation|aggregator]] and multinational financial technology company based in [[Gurgaon]]. The corporation was established in June 2008 by Yashish Dahiya,<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/policybazaar-co-founders-success-mantra-how-running-swimming-help-yashish-dahiya-stay-unbiased-at-work/articleshow/65222101.cms|title=Yashish Dahiya's success mantra: Running, swimming help him stay unbiased at work|last=Menon|first=Rashmi|date=2018-08-01|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022111249/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/policybazaar-co-founders-success-mantra-how-running-swimming-help-yashish-dahiya-stay-unbiased-at-work/articleshow/65222101.cms|url-status=live}}</ref> Alok Bansal<ref>{{Cite web|title=Alok Bansal, CFO/Co-Founder, Policybazaar Insurance Web Aggregator Pvt Ltd|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/20472655|website=www.bloomberg.com|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022100253/https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/20472655|url-status=live}}</ref> and Avaneesh Nirjar.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://inc42.com/buzz/insurance-company-policybazaar-explore-healthcare-tech-services|title=Online Insurance Company PolicyBazaar Gears Up To Explore Healthcare Tech And Services Market|date=2018-03-12|website=Inc42 Media|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022110932/https://inc42.com/buzz/insurance-company-policybazaar-explore-healthcare-tech-services/|url-status=live}}</ref> It provides a digital platform—website and an app—where users can compare [[Insurance policy|insurance policies]] and other financial services from major insurance companies. The company is India's largest insurance aggregator,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/real-issue/irda-could-stifle-online-insurance-aggregators/36081/1|title=IRDA Could Stifle Online Insurance Aggregators|website=Forbes India|language=en|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022100254/http://www.forbesindia.com/article/real-issue/irda-could-stifle-online-insurance-aggregators/36081/1|url-status=live}}</ref> and has == History ==
Policybazaar.com was founded in June 2008 by Yashish Dahiya, Alok Bansal, and Avaneesh Nirjar, starting out as an insurance comparison website.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/big-bet/for-policybazaar-health-cares-the-best-policy/50855/1|title=For PolicyBazaar, health care's the best policy|website=Forbes India|language=en|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022110928/http://www.forbesindia.com/article/big-bet/for-policybazaar-health-cares-the-best-policy/50855/1|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Forbes" /><ref name="ET">{{Cite news |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/india-emerging/policybazaar-gurgaon-based-start-up-offers-buyers-opportunity-to-compare-and-choose-insurance-policies/articleshow/9059348.cms |title=Policybazaar, Gurgaon based start-up offers buyers an opportunity to compare and choose insurance policies |last=Chatterjee |first=Paramita |date=11 July 2011 |work=The Economic Times |access-date=18 July 2018 |archive-date=18 July 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180718205153/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/india-emerging/policybazaar-gurgaon-based-start-up-offers-buyers-opportunity-to-compare-and-choose-insurance-policies/articleshow/9059348.cms |url-status=live }}</ref> At that time, the [[Insurance in India|Indian insurance industry]] still lacked transparency and policies were mostly sold through agents.<ref name="Quartz" /> Policybazaar started by listing the details of multiple insurance policies for customers to choose from.<ref name="Quartz" /><ref>{{Cite news |url=https://techcrunch.com/2018/06/25/indias-policybazaar-raises-200m-led-by-softbanks-vision-fund/ |title=India's PolicyBazaar raises $200M led by SoftBank's Vision Fund |last=Russell |first=Jon |date=25 June 2018 |work=TechCrunch |access-date=18 July 2018 |archive-date=18 July 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180718205903/https://techcrunch.com/2018/06/25/indias-policybazaar-raises-200m-led-by-softbanks-vision-fund/ |url-status=live }}</ref> It began as a price-comparison website,<ref name="Quartz" /> and an information portal for learning about insurance and insurance programs. The website subsequently expanded to become a marketplace for [[Insurance policy|insurance policies]]. In 2015, Policybazaar launched its app<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.pitchonnet.com/blog/2015/02/05/policybazaar-com-launches-mobile-app-consumers/|title=Policybazaar.com Launches Mobile App for Consumers|date=2015-02-05|website=PitchOnnet|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022110926/http://www.pitchonnet.com/blog/2015/02/05/policybazaar-com-launches-mobile-app-consumers/|url-status=live}}</ref> for [[Android (operating system)|Android]] and [[iOS]] users.

In February 2020, Sarbvir Singh was appointed CEO, effective December 2019, while Yashish Dahiya took over the role of group CEO.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://inc42.com/buzz/policybazaar-rejig-sarbvir-singh-replaces-cofounder-yashish-dahiya-as-ceo/amp/|title=PolicyBazaar Rejig: Sarbvir Singh Is New CEO; Cofounder Yashish Dahiya Named Group CEO|date=2020-02-20|website=Inc42|language=en|access-date=2020-02-22|archive-date=22 February 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200222150415/https://inc42.com/buzz/policybazaar-rejig-sarbvir-singh-replaces-cofounder-yashish-dahiya-as-ceo/amp/|url-status=live}}</ref>

In June 2021, Policybazaar obtained an [[Insurance broker|insurance broking]] licence from [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority|IRDAI]] and announced that it would set up 100 offline outlets across India. The company also surrendered its web aggregator licence.<ref>{{cite news |title=Policybazaar gets insurance broking licence |url=https://www.livemint.com/insurance/news/policybazaar-gets-insurance-broking-licence-11623402729722.html |access-date=9 November 2021 |work=mint |date=11 June 2021 |language=en |archive-date=9 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211109063304/https://www.livemint.com/insurance/news/policybazaar-gets-insurance-broking-licence-11623402729722.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Policybazaar.com forays into insurance brokerage, opens 15 retail stores |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/policybazaar-com-forays-into-insurance-brokerage-opens-15-retail-stores-121062500605_1.html |access-date=9 November 2021 |work=Business Standard India |date=25 June 2021 |archive-date=9 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211109063304/https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/policybazaar-com-forays-into-insurance-brokerage-opens-15-retail-stores-121062500605_1.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Products==
In 2021, Policybazaar moved from a policy price comparison website to an insurance selling operation. The company claims to process nearly 25% of India's life insurance and over 7% of the country's retail health cover.<ref name="Quartz" />

Policybazaar.com has tie-ups with insurance companies that help it procure information such as prices, benefits, insurance cover, etc. directly from the insurers. Users can use the Policybazaar website or app to research, compare and buy insurance policies from over 40 insurance providers. Policybazaar has companies that offer [[Vehicle insurance|car insurance]], [[health insurance]], [[life insurance]], corporate insurance, and [[travel insurance]] as its business partners.

The [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority|Insurance Regulatory And Development Authority of India]] regulates the insurance web aggregation business of Policybazaar. The company is registered as an insurance web aggregator under the Insurance Web Aggregator Regulations, 2017.<ref>[http://www.policyholder.gov.in/uploads/CEDocuments/Web%20Aggregators%20Regulations%202017.pdf Indian Insurance Regulatory and Development (InsuranceWeb- ) Regulations ) Regulations, 2017] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191101043027/http://www.policyholder.gov.in/uploads/CEDocuments/Web%20Aggregators%20Regulations%202017.pdf|date=1 November 2019}}</ref>

== Funding ==
[[Info Edge]] invested {{INRconvert|300|m|lk=r|year=2008|mode=historical}} as the seed fund in Policybazaar in mid 2008.<ref name=":0"/> Intel Capital and Info Edge invested {{INRconvert|600|m|lk=r|year=2011|mode=historical}} into Policybazaar in May 2011 as part of the venture round.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/policybazaar-raises-5-million-from-inventus-capital-info-edge-and-intel-capital/articleshow/19441695.cms|title=Policybazaar raises $5 million from Inventus Capital, Info Edge and Intel Capital|last=Gooptu|first=Biswarup|date=2013-04-08|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022111250/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/policybazaar-raises-5-million-from-inventus-capital-info-edge-and-intel-capital/articleshow/19441695.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

Policybazaar raised US$9 million from Intel Capital and Inventus Capital Partners in its Series A investment round.<ref name=":0" /> Policybazaar raised US$5 million in its third round of funding in April 2013. This Series B investment was led by Inventus Capital Partners along with Info Edge and Intel Capital.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/current/corporate/policybazaar-raises-$5-mn-from-inventus-capital-others/story/193906.html|title=Policybazaar raises $5 mn from Inventus Capital, others|website=www.businesstoday.in|date=8 April 2013|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022111936/https://www.businesstoday.in/current/corporate/policybazaar-raises-$5-mn-from-inventus-capital-others/story/193906.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/policybazaar-raises-5-million-from-inventus-capital-info-edge-and-intel-capital/articleshow/19441695.cms?from=mdr|title=Policybazaar raises $5 million from Inventus Capital, Info Edge and Intel Capital|last=Gooptu|first=Biswarup|date=2013-04-08|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=29 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191029111624/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/policybazaar-raises-5-million-from-inventus-capital-info-edge-and-intel-capital/articleshow/19441695.cms?from=mdr|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="techcircle.in">{{Cite web|url=https://www.techcircle.in/2014/05/26/online-insurance-policy-aggregator-policybazaar-raises-20m-more-valued-around-100m|title=Tiger Global invests $20M in Series C in online insurance policy aggregator PolicyBazaar|date=2014-05-26|website=Techcircle|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022111941/https://www.techcircle.in/2014/05/26/online-insurance-policy-aggregator-policybazaar-raises-20m-more-valued-around-100m|url-status=live}}</ref> In May 2014, Policybazaar.com raised $20 million in a Series C round of funding from existing investors including [[Tiger Global Management]].<ref name="techcircle.in"/>

Policybazaar raised around US$40 million in its Series D round of funding in April 2015 from Premji Invest, the personal investment vehicle of [[Wipro]] chairman [[Azim Premji]]. The Series D also attracted money from Steadview Capital and ABG Capital.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.vccircle.com/policybazaar-raises-around-40m-series-d-round-led-premjiinvest|title=PolicyBazaar raises around $40M in Series D round led by PremjiInvest|date=2015-04-14|website=VCCircle|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022111937/https://www.vccircle.com/policybazaar-raises-around-40m-series-d-round-led-premjiinvest|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://inc42.com/buzz/policybazaar-gets-40-mn-in-series-d-from-premjiinvest-steadview-abg-capital-existing-investors|title=PolicyBazaar Gets $40 Mn In Series D From PremJiInvest, Steadview, ABG Capital & Existing Investors|last=Singh|first=Vishal|date=2015-04-15|website=Inc42 Media|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022111943/https://inc42.com/buzz/policybazaar-gets-40-mn-in-series-d-from-premjiinvest-steadview-abg-capital-existing-investors/|url-status=live}}</ref> Policybazaar raised US$77 million in its Series E funding round. This was led by at least three new investors, including True North and IDG Venture Partners invested in this round. Also, several media reports claimed that Boston-based asset management firm Wellington Management Group invested in the online insurance aggregator.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.vccircle.com/policybazaar-raises-77-mn-in-series-e-funding|title=Policybazaar raises $77 mn in Series E funding|date=2017-10-13|website=VCCircle|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022111940/https://www.vccircle.com/policybazaar-raises-77-mn-in-series-e-funding|url-status=live}}</ref>

Policybazaar raised a total of US$238 million in June 2018 in its series F funding and became a [[unicorn (finance)|unicorn]] company.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/current/corporate/policybazaar-raises-usd-200-million-funding-round-led-softbank-enters-unicorn-club/story/279552.html|title=PolicyBazaar raises $200 million in a funding round led by SoftBank, enters the unicorn club|website=www.businesstoday.in|date=26 June 2018|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=22 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022110929/https://www.businesstoday.in/current/corporate/policybazaar-raises-usd-200-million-funding-round-led-softbank-enters-unicorn-club/story/279552.html|url-status=live}}</ref> Tokyo-based [[SoftBank Group]]'s Vision fund led the round with its US$150 million investment that gave it a 15% stake in the parent company of Policybazaar, ETechAces Marketing and Consulting. The Series F investment saw Info Edge put in $45 million in the company through a special purpose vehicle, effectively lifting its stake to 13% from 9%.<ref name=":4">{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/newsbuzz/indias-policybazaar-raises-over-200-mln-in-softbank-led-round/articleshow/64734167.cms|title=PolicyBazaar raises over $22238 million in SoftBank-led round|last=Gooptu|first=Biswarup|date=2018-06-26|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-10-22|archive-date=13 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210513141309/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/newsbuzz/indias-policybazaar-raises-over-200-mln-in-softbank-led-round/articleshow/64734167.cms|url-status=live}}</ref> In November 2019, [[Tencent]] acquired a 10% stake in the company at a valuation of $1.5 billion.<ref>{{cite news |title=Tencent Buys 10% of Policybazaar, Enters India Insurance Market |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-11-08/tencent-buys-10-of-policybazaar-enters-india-insurance-market |access-date=10 January 2025 |work=Bloomberg.com |date=8 November 2019 |language=en}}</ref> SoftBank invested an additional $130 million to increase its stake to 15% in July 2020, valuing Policybazaar at around U$1.5 billion.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chanchani |first1=Madhav |title=SoftBank buys more stake in PolicyBazaar in $130 million deal |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/softbank-buys-more-stake-in-policybazaar-in-130m-deal/articleshow/76776972.cms |website=The Times of India |date=4 July 2020 |access-date=26 October 2021 |language=en |archive-date=26 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211026195136/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/softbank-buys-more-stake-in-policybazaar-in-130m-deal/articleshow/76776972.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

In November 2021, PB Fintech Ltd., the parent company of Policybazaar, opened its [[initial public offering]] (IPO) and raised {{INRConvert|56.25|b|year=2021|mode=historical}}.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Sonavane |first1=Ravindra N. |title=Policybazaar IPO launch date announced: Price band, other details here |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/policybazaar-ipo-launch-date-announced-11635257212573.html |website=mint |access-date=26 October 2021 |language=en |date=26 October 2021 |archive-date=26 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211026171306/https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/policybazaar-ipo-launch-date-announced-11635257212573.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Shares of PB Fintech Ltd. began trading on [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] on 15 November 2021.<ref>{{cite web |title=Policybazaar Shares To Debut On Bourses On November 15 |url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/policybazaar-shares-to-debut-on-bourses-on-november-15-2610605 |website=NDTV.com |date=14 November 2021 |access-date=15 November 2021 |archive-date=15 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211115045005/https://www.ndtv.com/business/policybazaar-shares-to-debut-on-bourses-on-november-15-2610605 |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Controversies==
In early 2019, Policybazaar filed an intellectual property case against insurance company [[Acko General Insurance]] and Coverfox Insurance Broking Private Limited for trademark infringement.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-06-05 |title=Court Slaps INR 10 Lakh Fine On PolicyBazaar In Trademark Infringement Case Against Acko |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/court-slaps-inr-10-lakh-fine-on-policybazaar-in-trademark-infringement-case-against-acko |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191023070126/https://inc42.com/buzz/court-slaps-inr-10-lakh-fine-on-policybazaar-in-trademark-infringement-case-against-acko/ |archive-date=23 October 2019 |access-date=2019-10-23 |website=Inc42 Media |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2019-06-04 |title=HC imposes Rs 10 lakh cost on Policybazaar for concealing facts to obtain interim order |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/insure/hc-imposes-rs-10-lakh-cost-on-policybazaar-for-concealing-facts-to-obtain-interim-order/articleshow/69651079.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190927154150/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/insure/hc-imposes-rs-10-lakh-cost-on-policybazaar-for-concealing-facts-to-obtain-interim-order/articleshow/69651079.cms |archive-date=27 September 2019 |access-date=2019-10-23 |work=The Economic Times}}</ref>

In May 2021, the [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority|Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India]] (IRDAI) imposed a fine of {{INRConvert|2.4|m}} on Policybazaar for flouting norms related to [[SMS]] advertising.<ref>{{cite news |title=Policybazaar fined R.s. 24 lakh for flouting IRDAI's SMS ad rules |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/policybazaar-fined-rs-24-lakh-for-flouting-irdais-sms-ad-rules/articleshow/82802221.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210520145006/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/policybazaar-fined-rs-24-lakh-for-flouting-irdais-sms-ad-rules/articleshow/82802221.cms |archive-date=20 May 2021 |access-date=20 May 2021 |newspaper=The Economic Times |date=20 May 2021 |publisher=Rahul Awasthi}}</ref>

On 25 July 2022, Policybazaar acknowledged that there had been a data breach,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Livemint |date=2022-07-25 |title=Policybazaar says its IT systems were breached, authorities informed |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/it-system-compromised-says-policybazar-authorities-informed-11658707082611.html |access-date=2024-03-02 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref> resulting in over 50 million user data records being leaked. Cyberx9 reported that they identified the vulnerabilities, which seemed like "intentional backdoor vulnerabilities", which "did not get fixed until 7 days even though it would take about an hour to fix them".<ref>{{Cite web |title=Policybazaar — a major Indian insurance aggregator funded by a Chinese company — exposed sensitive and confidential personal, health, and financial data of around 56.4 million of its customers including defense personnels |url=https://www.cyberx9.com/china-policybazaar-millions-customers-defense-data-exposed-blog |access-date=2024-03-02 |website=www.cyberx9.com}}</ref>

On 6 December 2023, Policybazaar sends [[defamation]] notice to insurance review platform Beshak Solutions Private Limited.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mathi |first=Sarvesh |date=2023-12-14 |title=Policybazaar sends defamation notice to Beshak.org |url=https://www.medianama.com/2023/12/223-policybazaar-defamation-notice-beshak/ |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=MediaNama |language=en-US}}</ref>

[[Goods and Services Tax (India)|GST]] officials raided PB Fintech's Gurugram office on 13 January 2025, focusing on vendors linked to its subsidiary, PB Partners, which manages offline [[insurance]] distribution for Policybazaar. The company confirmed full cooperation with authorities and stated no financial impact from the raid. Further details remain undisclosed.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-01-16 |title=GST officials conduct search operations at Policybazaar office |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/gst-officials-conduct-search-operations-at-policybazaar-office/articleshow/117270461.cms |access-date=2025-02-08 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref>

extract:
Policybazaar is an Indian insurance aggregator and multinational financial technology company based in Gurgaon. The corporation was established in June 2008 by Yashish Dahiya, Alok Bansal and Avaneesh Nirjar. It provides a digital platform—website and an app—where users can compare insurance policies and other financial services from major insurance companies. The company is India's largest insurance aggregator, and has expanded its operations to the United Arab Emirates.
Policybazaar is the flagship subsidiary of PB Fintech Ltd., which also owns the credit product aggregator Paisabazaar.
